passages.text: The EU sets a maximum of 1,000 µg/kg cadmium for food supplements (as placed on the market; this is the supplement row, not a rice-protein row). It sets 150 µg/kg cadmium for rice, quinoa, wheat bran and wheat gluten (a commodity row, not rice protein) (commodity row).
